biography_english:
A Galgastani from Brigantys. She is the daughter of the Necromancer Nybeth. She resented her father's debasement of human life, and sought solace in the Order. When her brother Dievold fell victim to Nybeth's necromancy, she resolved to confront him. Together with Dievold she set off to locate their father.
  They tracked him to the Palace of the Dead, where he revealed she was his wife and not his daughter. He spoke of fusing the soul of his dead wife with his daughter Amala's body, but the particulars of the matter are not clear.
biography_spanish:
Una galgastani de Brigantys. Es hija del nigromante Nybeth. Rechazaba como su padre degradaba la vida humana y busco consuelo en la Orden. Cuando su hermano Dievold fue victima de la nigromancia de Nybeth, decidio enfrentarlo. Junto a Dievold partio para buscar a su padre.                                   
  Lo rastrearon hasta el Palacio de los Muertos, donde revelo que ella era su esposa y no su hija. Hablo de fusionar el alma de su difunta esposa con el cuerpo de su hija Amala, pero los detalles del asunto no estan claros.

biography_english: A Galgastani sibyl. She was attacked by undead after traveling to Balmamusa to care for those suffering from the ravages of war. She was rescued by the Resistance, but later succumbed to the wounds she incurred in the battle.

biography_english:
A mage from a far-off land who seeks to uncover the draconic magic of legend. He is well-versed in the subject, his knowledge surpassing even the greatest Valerian scholars. Nothing is known of his past.
  {hero} saved him from undead creatures in the Palace of the Dead. Hearing that the Resistance was exploring the palace, he asked to join forces with them.
